title: Kubernetes Goat
description: Madhu Akula's intentionally vulnerable Kubernetes cluster: about twenty scenarios covering secrets in code and image layers, SSRF to internal services, container escape to the host, docker-in-docker, RBAC misconfiguration, private registry attacks and namespace bypass.
question: Solve the Kubernetes Goat scenarios listed for this lab: find each scenario's flag or answer, and escape to the node to read /root/flag.txt.
